faultLoc.explanation: The NullPointerException is thrown because the 'other' object is null. The code attempts to access the 'size' field of the 'other' object without checking if 'other' is null. This is the direct cause of the exception.
The equals method should include a null check for the 'other' object before accessing its fields. Adding a null check at the beginning of this method can prevent the NullPointerException.
